mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.product_id, c.amount, c.is_selected, p.name AS product_name, p.price AS product_price, p.stock AS product_stock, (SELECT url FROM pms_product_img WHERE product_id = c.product_id AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1) AS product_img FROM oms_cart c LEFT JOIN pms_product p ON p.id = c.product_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
